extra.reason: Landed as a memoizing TermCache on Store. Measured ~3.9-4.9x on the 2-hop join, ~1.4x on the type scan, ingest unchanged. Follow-up quipu-h03 filed for the unbounded growth.

Landed as TWO features rather than one: 'remote' (ureq, the federation client) and 'server' (axum/tower-http/tokio, implying remote). Verified cargo tree --no-default-features has no axum/tower-http/tokio/ureq/mio/hyper. The wasm build now gets past mio and stops at getrandom (quipu-gsg). CI matrix gained a 'remote' entry in both clippy and test.

Rewritten as a ratchet. .file-size-baseline grandfathers the 23 existing violators at their current size; they may shrink, growing fails. New violations fail outright. pre-commit runs --staged (quiet, sufficient — growth only arrives via staged changes); CI runs the authoritative full scan plus scripts/test-check-file-size.sh, 7 tests covering the behaviours including that --update-baseline never loosens.

src/store/read_model.rs: three permutation indexes over one graph's current facts, Store::build_read_model(graph), apply/apply_all for incremental maintenance. 12 tests, load-bearing ones differential. Deliberately inert — nothing consults it, and it is not stored on Store, because residency and invalidation belong with the scope guard (quipu-syt). Measured: 246ms build / 55.5MB / 0.259ms 2-hop join at 10k episodes, FASTER and smaller than the prototype because the term dictionary now lives on Store from quipu-yzf.

Bounded at DEFAULT_TERM_CACHE_LIMIT (500k terms, ~175MB at the measured 350 bytes/term), adjustable via Store::set_term_cache_limit; 0 disables caching and drops what is held. At the cap it refuses admission rather than evicting — every policy is correct since a miss reads SQL, and eviction under a full-dictionary scan just thrashes. 3 tests including that warm_term_cache respects the cap.

NOT superlinear — the finding was a measurement error on my part. The 118/745/2768ms figures were COLD (first touch of an 83MB file); warm, project() is 13.0/24.2/48.5/134.5ms at 1k/2k/4k/10k episodes, which is linear (1.86x, 2.00x, 2.77x for 2x, 2x, 2.5x the data) and ~20x faster than published. project() does not resolve per fact, so the term cache was not the cause either. Design doc corrected in place. What remains true is that it is UNCACHED and paid per call, and that scoping it to a named graph composes with quipu-nip — refiled as quipu-8em.

The write path now vouches for its complete change set when it can (Staged::effective), and the model is MAINTAINED rather than dropped. It cannot vouch when OWL inference extends the batch or functional supersede closes prior values via bulk UPDATE ... WHERE v != ? — those rebuild. A write to a different graph leaves a ROOT model untouched entirely. The structural enabler was suspending model consultation for the duration of a write instead of dropping it, which also retired both invalidation bugs.

Complete and ON by default. eval_bgp hash-joins through the model for multi-pattern BGPs behind the scope guard. No measured regression on any query shape; 27x-310x on joins. Single-pattern BGPs deliberately stay on SQL (routing them through the model was a 0.12ms -> 320ms regression). Size bounded at 1M triples, checked with a COUNT. Differential test over 10 multi-pattern shapes plus the full 1020-test suite run with the model on.

Hash join implemented in eval_bgp: each pattern evaluated once and joined on shared variables, smaller side built. Turns the 2-hop join linear — 27x to 310x faster (173,803ms -> 560ms at 10k episodes). LIMIT pushdown and selectivity ORDERING remain, refiled.

Phases 1-4 execute end to end. Gated arm: all 6 defect probes refused (SHACL episode gate, authority intersection x2, policy claim, post-state-only claim, closed-world vocabulary), escalation approve/reject round-trips work, RQ2 = 0/6 defects present; control arm: 6/6 present. Shipped as a Sigma entry: urn:census:policy:closed-vocabulary, a deny policy whose ASK claim requires every predicate on a census:Record to be typed census:DeclaredPredicate. Refuses CEN-V1 in the gated arm; lands in control. Finding: claims must scope patterns with GRAPH ?g when governed facts live in named graphs.

GS6's store half is done: the bitemporal shapes+ontologies registry landed as quipu #71 (close-dont-overwrite, PK (name, valid_from), registry events, as-of reads on store API and MCP tool, migration for existing stores, full test coverage). Verified against the design doc and updated its stale 'Designed, not built' banner. The remaining half - as-of Sigma in audit/replay (design §2.3, fidelity vs drift) - is exactly quipu-tj0's scope.

As-of replay lands in Census phases 5-6: mid-run amendment supersedes the tally claim (Sigma is bitemporal facts) and reloads the record shape through the versioned registry; CEN-M1 refused under amended Sigma; replay re-derives 50/50 satisfied verdicts faithfully as-of their instant while all 50 would misreport under latest-only Sigma, and 3/3 denials verify rules-in-force (the staged delta is rolled back by design - GS2 keeps the verdict, not the attempt; recorded as a finding). In-store audit: inventory 1 violation/1 incompleteness as planted (G1/G2), trace audit 0 violations/1 incompleteness (T1's attribution hole). RQ5 and RQ3 in-store metrics measured.

Exporter + driver landed and measured: phase 6 exports Sigma (spec.yaml) and two trace variants in the reference checker's formats; sarc_check.py scores them through besanson/sarc-governance's own load_spec/audit_trace. Result on seed-42: faithful trace (abstention visible) fails only on coverage - 168 discrepancies, all coverage type, zero verdict/placement/response disagreements; padded trace passes clean. The disagreement is coverage semantics (the reference checker assumes evaluate-everything-per-action; quipu's target-type pre-filter is invisible to it) - the RQ3 finding, recorded in BUILD_REPORT.md.

Recorded a genuine trace from hank's real pre-edit guard (hank aee6beb, enforce mode, 2 denies + 3 allows against a blast-radius scope) and replayed it through the real quipu audit CLI with the shipped treesitter policy catalog as Sigma. Result: T does not entail Sigma - the audit surfaced a real enforcement gap (hank's config-file max_impacted_files rule enforces outside the authored specification; remediation in the finding), plus unexercised constraints, undeclared placement, and partial attribution, each as incompleteness not violation. Trace + replay instructions + verbatim result committed at benchmark/census/wild/.

DETERMINISM.md landed with measured hashes: manifests byte-identical per (seed, arm) across repeat runs (3x gated e5f5f1.., 2x control 248611..), sarc-export byte-stable, RQ2/4/5 value-identical, RQ1 latency-varying by design. One real divergence found while measuring - CEN-X1's observed string embedded the absolute out dir - fixed and recorded in place per the withdraw-in-place discipline. Deliberate non-stability of .db files (registry wall-clock, per-environment signing key) documented with the content-hash identity story.

Committed a genuine single-model demonstration: an LLM writer authored attempt1 cold (2 accepted, 3 refused - missing label, out-of-authority district, fabricated predicate), revised strictly from the refusal text, and attempt2 landed 5/5 with zero final-graph defects. The controlled multi-task experiment stays future work pending camayoc's competency runner; documented as n=1 existence demonstration, not a rate.

project_in_graph scopes the scan to one named graph (unknown IRI refuses); project_cached memoizes the last projection on Store keyed by (graph, filters) and stamped with latest_tx_id, so repeat calls over an unchanged graph never repeat the scan. MCP tool + CLI gained a graph param; docs updated; 4 new tests; full gate green.

Store::prune_events deletes by age, never past MIN(committed_offset) over registered consumers; opt-in via [quipu.events] retention_days (default unset = keep forever, today's behaviour); server prunes hourly when configured. Measured on the 10k-episode store: 83.3MB -> 53.5MB after VACUUM (35.8% reduction, 100,012 events). Docs: wasm-support §5.1 note + book configuration page.

Both halves landed. LIMIT pushdown: Slice installs a row cap through prefix-safe subtrees only (Project/Reduced); the BGP leaf stops the lazy SQL scan once enough rows BOUND. Type scan now flat: 0.51ms@1k -> 0.63ms@10k (was 100.21ms@10k); bounded 2-hop join 1050ms -> 566ms. Ordering: join_plan folds hash joins by measured cardinality (smallest, then connected-smallest, deterministic tie-break); pathological source order provably produces the same plan (unit test) and identical results (integration test). 5 new tests; full gate green.
